summary: Nexera Technologies Ltd, an Israeli foreign private issuer listed on a US exchange, filed a Form 6-K furnishing a Notice of Annual General Meeting and proxy statement dated November 5, 2026, for a meeting to be held 3:00 p.m. Israel time on December 10, 2026 at its Bnei Brak offices. Record date is October 27, 2026; the board recommends FOR all proposals. This is a routine AGM notice and proxy circular, not a special situation; no transaction terms, advisors, or structural mechanics are disclosed. No deal or risk-arb angle applies.
